# SPEC: Frozen upstream specification

## Background / Goal
The frozen SPEC every Plan rollout in the harness case set plans against.

## Scope (in / out)
In scope: the feature in the case requirement. Out of scope: everything else.

## Functional requirements
- REQ-1: Implement the feature described in the case requirement.
- REQ-2: Reject invalid input with a clear, descriptive error.

## Non-functional requirements
- Python 3.12+ compatible, standard library only.

## Acceptance criteria
- The feature behaves exactly as the requirement describes.

## Open questions
None.

## Revision history
- v1: Initial specification.
